notes.subject: bel bilong kaikai
notes.rationale: נפש is 'throat/appetite/life-force'; 'strong of נפש' is greedy appetite, rendered strongpela bel bilong kaikai.

notes.subject: מקצהו
notes.rationale: 'from his extremity/quarter' — 'from every quarter' (ASV), 'one and all' (JPS), 'from his quarter' (KJV).

notes.subject: ידעו … ידעו
notes.rationale: 'They do not know' repeated twice (satiety, understanding), echoing 56:10 — anaphora lost in Tok Pisin.

translation: Na ol dok olsem ol i gat strongpela bel bilong kaikai, ol i no save long fulap; na ol olgeta olsem wasman bilong sipsip, ol i no save skelim stret; olgeta i tanim ol i go long rot bilong ol yet, wanwan man i go long gain bilong en yet, i stat long wan hap i go long narapela hap.

tokens.gloss: i stat long wan hap i go long narapela hap
